==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Wolverine&min=Wolverine&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/WolverineTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Wolverine&min=Wolverine&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using VerifyTests.Wolverine;

// Verify.Wolverine: Verifies a Wolverine message handler by recording everything it sends, publishes, invokes and broadcasts.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Wolverine
// Note: VerifyWolverine.Initialize() only sets Initialized: it registers no converters and does
// nothing else. It exists so plugin discovery has something to find, which is why no call is
// generated.
// Note: The real API here is RecordingMessageContext. Pass it into the handler as its IMessageBus,
// then verify the context.
// Note: Recorded messages arrive under Sent, Published, Invoked and Broardcasted, alongside
// Envelope, CorrelationId, TenantId and UserName.
// Note: Broardcasted is misspelled in the public API, so the sample matches it (retired by the
// rename in 22.4).
// Note: Request and reply through InvokeAsync<T> needs AddInvokeResult<T>, either a delegate
// computing the reply from the message or a constant.
// Note: Nothing external is needed: the context is in memory, so the tests run anywhere.
// Note: The package targets net9.0 only.
public class WolverineTests
{
    // RecordingMessageContext is an IMessageBus that records instead of sending, so the handler
    // runs unchanged with no broker, no host and no infrastructure.
    // Verifying the context covers every message and every delivery option in one snapshot,
    // rather than one assertion per property.
    [Fact]
    public async Task HandlerSends()
    {
        var context = new RecordingMessageContext();
        var handler = new OrderHandler(context);

        await handler.Handle(new("the reference"));

        await Verify(context);
    }
}
